'''R77''' was one of the many [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] active in the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]]. R77 served aboard the ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]'', the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Scrapbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
R77 appeared in a deleted scene from [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] in which the super battle droid was one of several super droids who, aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], tried to capture [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. However, R77 was destroyed when the generator room was exploded by Skywalker.<ref name="IIIDVD">{{Film|III}} DVD</ref> R77 was identified as one of these droids in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']].<ref name="Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> The character was still confirmed to exist within the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe through ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''.<ref name="Scrapbook" />
